stories.text: 🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: The Mahomies vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: The Mahomies 32% / 6.2%, Mr. Action Jackson 48% / 17%.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 4 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 108.04 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 25.80 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Mr. Action Jackson: 59% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 23%).
📈 LINE MOVE: PIT @ PHI: PHI −5.5 at open, PIT −4.5 now. News: "Sources: Mason McCormick avoided ankle fracture; Steelers place guard on IR"
🏟️ Game to watch: IND @ HOU (Thursday 8:15 PM), 11 league starters in action with 134.05 pts up for grabs. It could swing Ramosverse vs Kyle Tucker by 22%.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (IND @ HOU): 11 league starters in action. Most riding on it: The Mahomies vs Mr. Action Jackson (43.63 pts projected).
🔢 MAGIC NUMBER: Brock You Like a Hurricane clinches a first-round bye with 2 more wins. A sweep this week (beat 49er Faith-Fool and the median) does it.
📈 LINE MOVE: IND @ HOU: HOU −5.5 at open, HOU −12.5 now. 11 league starters in it, led by C. Stroud (Ramosverse).
🔭 Player to watch: C.J. Stroud (IND @ HOU). ESPN projects 22.24 pts, and Ramosverse is 59% against Kyle Tucker.
🤝 Rivalry week: The Mahomies leads Mr. Action Jackson 5–2 all-time.
🔥 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy has won 7 straight. TDsMaGee gets the next crack at them.
📈 TRENDING: Every other league is scrambling for Seth McGowan (RB, IND). Ours has him sitting on waivers.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 7.2% against The Mahomies — and won.
💓 49er Faith-Fool outlasted TDsMaGee after the favorite flipped 3 times.
